verbs.name: not set
verbs.description: no verb / predicate selected

verbs.name: is a
verbs.description: the main child to parent relation e.g. Zurich is a canton. The reverse is valid and usually plural is used e.g. cantons are Zurich, Bern, ...

verbs.name: is part of
verbs.description: if several similar term create different views to the same sum; E.g. Cash Flow Paper, Balance Sheet and Income statement are Financial Statements. Or sectors and Regions are different splittings

verbs.name: can be part of
verbs.description: if the assigment is optional in both directions e.g. a base unit can be a SI unit but not all SI units are base units

verbs.name: of
verbs.description: to narrow a selection e.g. the world population is usually the population of all humans

verbs.name: with
verbs.description: similar to 'is part of' but where the left phrase is expected to be several times the right phrase e.g. for comparing same by same: 1 hour with full load is the same as 2 hours with half load

verbs.name: has a
verbs.description: to assign potential properties e.g. a country has a Human Development Index

verbs.name: is time jump for
verbs.description: the default time jump e.g year is the default time period for annual reports

verbs.name: is term jump for
verbs.description: the default term jump e.g. state of aggregation is used for a physical substance

verbs.name: term type needed
verbs.description: the formula needs the linked term type

verbs.name: is follower of
verbs.description: the time order of two phrases e.g. 2025 is follower of 2024; for the table column order use 'is next main column after' or 'is explaining column for'

verbs.name: uses
verbs.description: real use e.g. wind energy is used by a wind turbine

verbs.name: issue
verbs.description: e.g. a company issues an annual report

verbs.name: is measure type for
verbs.description: is the default measure type for

verbs.name: is an acronym for
verbs.description: is an acronym for

verbs.name: can be used as a differentiator for
verbs.description: similar to contains, but in a table view the row will not be shown if there is no corresponding value
verbs.name_plural: can be used as a differentiator for

verbs.name: can
verbs.description: to assign a behavior e.g. GDP can decline

verbs.name: can use
verbs.description: use indicates that a new result is created e.g. a turbine can use water or wind or any type of liquid or gas to convert energy

verbs.name: scaled by
verbs.description: to define the usual scaling e.g. for watt hours usually the scaling kilo (kWh) is used

verbs.name: per
verbs.description: to define the usual quotient e.g. meter per second is normally used not seconds per meter, that why the reverse name is empty

verbs.name: times
verbs.description: to multiply the two given phrases to one unit e.g. Joule times second (J⋅s) for the Plank constant

verbs.name: is selector for
verbs.description: used to group a selection list to make it shorter

verbs.name: is symbol for
verbs.description: is used as a symbol for

verbs.name: can cause
verbs.description: there is a causal relation with a factor

verbs.name: and
verbs.description: combine two phrases a a new phrase

verbs.name: on
verbs.description: to specify a subgroup e.g. taxes on income

verbs.name: in
verbs.description: to specify the measure unit

verbs.name: to
verbs.description: to define a time period e.g. "12:00 to 13:00" or "1. March 2024 to 3. March 2024 or to specify the assignment type e.g. net to net for currency turnover

verbs.name: is ranked by
verbs.description: to define which values should be used to sort related objects e.g. the first math const are the once that have been discovered first because they are probably the most relevant and useful

verbs.name: between
verbs.description: to define a range e.g. a value between a lower and an upper bound

verbs.name: kind of
verbs.description: to assign a sub kind to a parent category e.g. the quadratic formula is a kind of formula

verbs.name: name of
verbs.description: to assign a proper name to a category e.g. the Pythagorean theorem is named after Pythagoras

verbs.name: by parts
verbs.description: to describe a method that operates on the parts of an expression e.g. integration by parts

verbs.name: must be one of
verbs.description: to disambiguate a word that has several meanings by pinning each meaning to its own triple e.g. the word 'second' must be one of 'time unit' or 'ranking number'; the qualifier triple is referenced instead of the ambiguous word and only the original word is shown on a page while the qualifier appears in the tooltip

verbs.name: is used by
verbs.description: passive form of 'uses' when the dependent phrase is the subject e.g. cent is used by Euro

verbs.name: can be made of
verbs.description: to specify possible materials or composition options e.g. a porringer can be made of plastic

verbs.name: can be packed in
verbs.description: to specify possible packaging options e.g. a blueberry can be packed in a plastic porringer

verbs.name: used for
verbs.description: to specify the intended purpose of a phrase e.g. fuel used for a jet (jet fuel)

verbs.name: is next main column after
verbs.description: to chain the main table columns e.g. the solution column is the next main column after the problem column and all columns explaining the problem; for a time order use 'is follower of'

verbs.name: is explaining column for
verbs.description: to attach a column that explains a main table column e.g. the loss column gives the size of the problem column; an explaining column is shown between its main column and the next main column

verbs.name: supports
verbs.description: to state that one argument or finding backs a claim e.g. a premise supports a conclusion

verbs.name: explains
verbs.description: to state that one phrase gives the reason for another e.g. a mechanism explains an observation

verbs.name: refines
verbs.description: to state that one phrase makes another more precise without replacing it e.g. a strategy refines a claim

verbs.name: is evidence for
verbs.description: to state that an observation is empirical evidence for a claim e.g. a historical failure is evidence for a premise

verbs.name: is analogous to
verbs.description: to state that two phrases share the same structure without one causing the other e.g. one dilemma is analogous to another

verbs.name: limits
verbs.description: to state that one phrase bounds how far another can go e.g. a risk limits a reduction claim

verbs.name: enables
verbs.description: to state that one phrase makes another possible without causing it e.g. a border adjustment enables a climate club

verbs.name: reduces
verbs.description: to state that one phrase lowers the size of another e.g. a border adjustment reduces carbon leakage

verbs.name: adds to
verbs.description: to state that one amount is added to another to form the total e.g. a regional premium adds to the base price

verbs.name: competes with
verbs.description: to state that two options exclude or weaken each other e.g. throttling competes with implementing

verbs.name: aims to trigger
verbs.description: to state the intended effect of an action e.g. an annoyance test aims to trigger a one-click hide
verbs.name_plural_reverse: are aimed to be triggered by
verbs.name_reverse: is aimed to be triggered by

verbs.name: lowers barrier for
verbs.description: to state that one phrase makes another easier to reach e.g. a low implementation cost lowers the barrier for building it

verbs.name: is single attempt in
verbs.description: to state that one try is one of the attempts an ensemble rate is computed from

verbs.name: expected from
verbs.description: to name the expected value of an outcome e.g. the harm expected from a runaway

verbs.name: weighted by
verbs.description: to state that a quantity is multiplied by a weight e.g. an expected harm weighted by the confidence
